lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
መድኃኒት ዕፀ ሕይወት /2/
ዝንቱ ውእቱ መስቀል /2/
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]መድኃኒቶሙ ለእስራኤል /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]በኣምሳለ ኣርዌ ብርት ዘገዳም /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ዘኣግብኦ ለኣዳም /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ገነተ ተድላ ወትፍስሕት /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ሓይልነ ወጸወንነ /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ለእለ ነኣምን መድኃኒትነ /2/[[/highlight]]

ያድህኖሙ በመስቀሉ
ይትቤዘዎሙ በመስቀሉ
[[highlight]]ለእለ ኣምኑ በኃይሉ /2/[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Medhanit ʿitse hiywet /2/
Zintu wiʾitu mesqel /2/
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]Medhanitomu leʾisraʾel /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Beʾamsale ʾarwe birt zegedam /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Zeʾagbiʾo leʾadam /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Genete tedla wetfishit /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Hayline wetsewenne /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Leʾile neʾamn medhanitne /2/[[/highlight]]

Yadhinomu bemesqelu
Yitbezewomu bemesqelu
[[highlight]]Leʾile ʾamnu behaylu /2/[[/highlight]]
